slug: 吞天混沌经开局先吞圣女修为
content_zh:
第23章仙界阵法
众人的话透着一股浓浓的悲怆，十年前的惨剧历历在目，而现在，历史又要重演，
但十年前至少还有那个叫做江烈的汉子，可是现在呢，那些曾经信誓旦旦与大家共进退的家族贵胄早离开了天武城，剩下的武者中，最强的不过凝气十重，拿什么去抵挡妖兽进攻？
江海着急忙慌的给江尘收拾着行礼，
“江尘，你们俩快走，兽群快到了，天武城是不能待了。”
江尘叹了口气，现在的情况，恐怕比老爷子想的还要糟糕，
“爷爷，不用收拾了，早上离开天武城的那些人，现在恐怕已经死光了...”
...
天武城外百里处，
一行数百人向大城进发，虽然山地间灌木丛生，古木参天，但这些人大都凝气期以上修为，有几人甚至已经到达了先天境，奔行极为迅速，突然，最前方的武者骤然站住，
“嗷呜~”
低沉的啸声响起，此起彼伏，环绕在他们四周，
山林中出现了无数双血红的眼睛，如同鬼火一般飘荡，终于，那片鬼火走出山林，
“妖...妖兽！”
“好大....好大的狼！”
所有的人惊悚，他们前方，竟出现了上百头巨狼，每一头都有两丈大小，如同巨象一般，血盆大口中流着涎水，獠牙足有半尺长，阴寒森然，狰狞无比。
上百头二阶妖狼，寻常在山林中能见到一头都极为罕见，而此时，丛林中竟出现了上百头，
“嗷呜~~”
一声狼啸，那些巨狼开始发起冲锋，
“啊！

！”
人群中一声凄厉惨叫传来，一个身穿华服的少年被妖狼撕下半边身子，他曾是巨富之子，本可一生荣华富贵，此时却命丧妖狼口中，
那富商失去儿子，嚎丧一般大哭，
“救救我儿子，救我儿子，我给你们一万两，不，十万两！”
话还没说完，他被两头巨狼撕成两半，瞬间吞噬入腹，
几个先天期的武者真元涌动，他们是天武城有数的高手，此时气息爆发，引起一阵飓风，
“杀！
掩护族人撤退！”
“杀！
为族人报仇！”
“我来挡住妖狼！”
一个中年男子跨出一步，先天期的真元猛然涌出，长剑洞穿妖狼咽喉，
可妖狼实在太多，数百人的队伍转眼被吞噬过半，
他们虽能自保，却无法守护族人，只能眼睁睁的看着亲人被妖兽吞吃，他们燃烧真元，眼含血泪，若在城中，或有一战之力，可此时悔之晚矣，
足足半个时辰，在几大高手的奋力屠杀下，妖狼死伤殆尽，但他们的几乎灭族，每个人都几乎崩溃，整片山林都弥漫着血腥味，
“快撤，血腥味定会引来其他妖兽！”
话还未必，远处山林中如同山洪暴发，妖兽吼叫惊破天际，震耳欲聋，向着这边疾速冲来，
“嗷...”
山林摇晃，大地震颤，山怪、狡狰、金睛猿、巨犀兽...数不尽的妖兽从山林中冲出冲，巨木折断，山石崩碎，如同洪水奔流，看不到边际，景象恐怖至极。
content_en:
Chapter 23 Immortal Formation
There was a deep sadness in everyone's words. The tragedy ten years ago was still vivid in our minds, but now, history is about to repeat itself.
But ten years ago, at least there was that man named Jiang Lie, but now, those family nobles who once swore to advance and retreat with everyone have long since left Tianwu City. Among the remaining warriors, the strongest is only the tenth level of Qi Condensation. What can they do to resist the attack of the monsters?
Jiang Hai hurriedly packed up and saluted Jiang Chen.
"Jiang Chen, you two leave quickly, the beast herd is coming soon, and we can't stay in Tianwu City any longer."
Jiang Chen sighed, the current situation is probably worse than the old man thought.
"Grandpa, there's no need to clean up. Those who left Tianwu City in the morning are probably all dead now..."
...
A hundred miles outside Tianwu City,
A group of hundreds of people marched towards the big city. Although the mountains were thick with bushes and the ancient trees were towering, most of these people were at the Qi Condensation stage or above. Some of them had even reached the Xiantian stage. They were running extremely fast. Suddenly, the warrior at the front suddenly stopped.
"Ouch~"
Low whistles sounded, one after another, surrounding them,
Countless pairs of blood-red eyes appeared in the forest, floating like will-o'-the-wisps. Finally, the will-o'-the-wisp came out of the forest,
"Monster...monster!"
"What a big...what a big wolf!"
Everyone was horrified. In front of them, hundreds of giant wolves appeared. Each one was two feet in size, like a giant elephant, with saliva flowing from its bloody mouth. Its fangs were half a foot long. They were cold and ferocious.
There are hundreds of second-level demon wolves. It is extremely rare to see one in the mountain forest. But at this time, there are hundreds of them in the jungle.
"Ouch~~"
With a wolf howl, the giant wolves began to charge,
"Ah!
! "
A shrill scream came from the crowd, and a young man in rich clothes was torn off half of his body by the demon wolf. He was once the son of a wealthy man, and he could have lived a prosperous life, but now he died at the mouth of the demon wolf.
The wealthy businessman lost his son and cried like a mourner.
"Save my son, save my son, I will give you ten thousand taels, no, one hundred thousand taels!"
Before he finished speaking, he was torn in half by two giant wolves and swallowed instantly.
The true energy of several innate-stage warriors surged, and they were among the few masters in Tianwu City. At this moment, their aura erupted, causing a hurricane.
"Kill!
Cover the tribe's retreat! "
"Kill!
Revenge for the clan! "
"I'll stop the demon wolf!"
A middle-aged man took a step forward, his innate-stage true energy suddenly surged out, and his long sword pierced the demon wolf's throat.
But there were too many monster wolves, and more than half of the team of hundreds of people was swallowed up in an instant.
Although they can protect themselves, they cannot protect their people. They can only watch their loved ones being devoured by monsters. They burn their true energy, with blood and tears in their eyes. If they are in the city, they may have the strength to fight, but it is too late to regret now.
For half an hour, under the fierce slaughter of several masters, the demon wolves were completely killed and injured, but their clan was almost wiped out, everyone almost collapsed, and the entire mountain forest was filled with the smell of blood.
"Quickly retreat, the smell of blood will definitely attract other monsters!"
The words were not yet certain. It was like a flash flood erupting in the distant mountains and forests. Monster beasts roared in the sky, deafening, and rushed towards this side.
"Ouch..."
The mountain forest shook, the earth trembled, mountain monsters, cunning beasts, golden-eyed apes, giant rhinoceros beasts... countless monsters rushed out of the mountain forest, huge trees broke, rocks collapsed, like a rushing flood, no edge could be seen, and the scene was extremely terrifying.
